sources.title: Reza2kn/Gooya-RizehPizeh-v1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gooya RizehPizeh v1.5 Persian (Farsi) text-to-speech voice "gooya-fa" for Piper, trained with the AvaSanj/Negara improved G2P front end. Single-speaker, 22050 Hz, phoneme_type: text (no espeak-ng required at inference time).

sources.title: Reza2kn/gooya-0.1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gooya 0.1 Gooya 0.1 is a Persian neural TTS model — a LoRA fine-tune of MOSS-TTS-Nano (100M) trained on 48k Persian clips phonemized with the Gooya clean G2P (Reza2kn/negara-g2p-clean).
